label.explanation: payment-svc briefly lost one of four instances (lines 275, 280) and was back within a minute (line 284). But order-service retries 503s immediately with backoff disabled (lines 282, 292, 297, 301), multiplying load on payment-svc past its capacity so it keeps shedding (lines 288, 299, 306). The overload sustains itself long after the trigger; the shed requests (lines 294, 300, 310, 321, 332, 346, 361, 378) and edge 503s (lines 291, 293, 302, 307, 316, 324, 331, 342, 344, 358, 367, 379) are symptoms. Fix the retry policy / add a retry budget. The trigger was the payment-svc rollout, so bad_deploy is defensible, but a 1-of-4 rolling restart is routine — the retry amplification is the failure. Red herrings: line 254 (a one-off slow reporting query on audit_log, not on the failing request path); lines 245, 253 (a deploy of order-consumer, which is not on the failing request path and kept processing normally); line 48 (a routine disk usage warning on the log volume, nowhere near full); line 279 (a single long GC pause in a healthy service, with heap well below limits).
